verdict.rationale:
SES documents event publishing (bounces, complaints, deliveries) to CloudWatch/SNS/Firehose/EventBridge via configuration sets, which supports tracking what happened to sent mail, but the evidence never mentions open/click tracking events specifically nor any API to query a per-message event history on demand (SES's model is push-based notifications, not a query-by-message-id API). Community evidence corroborates that senders must build their own logging/reporting on top of SES rather than getting built-in delivery reports ('You also need to code a lot of the stuff Mailchimp has out of the box like... delivery reports yourself').

missing for 10: explicit documentation of open/click event tracking, and a documented API/endpoint to query the full event history for a specific message by ID.
